items.question: What orthodontic options do you offer?

items.question: Do you accept insurance or offer payment plans?

props.body: Priya Ramanathan blends contemporary aesthetics with functional precision, drawing on over a decade of residential and commercial projects. Her approach prioritizes client collaboration, sustainable material selection, and timeless spatial narratives.

image.alt: Priya Ramanathan reviewing design concepts in her studio

sections.brief: Cards highlighting core services such as space planning, colour consultancy, custom furnishings, and project management.

items.title: Space Planning
items.body: We develop functional layouts that optimise flow and maximise the potential of each area, aligning with the client’s lifestyle and objectives.

items.title: Colour Consultancy
items.body: Our colour consultancy provides curated palettes that enhance ambience, complement furnishings, and reflect the client’s aesthetic preferences.

items.title: Custom Furnishings
items.body: We design and source bespoke furniture pieces tailored to the client’s specifications, ensuring unique, high‑quality solutions for every project.

items.title: Project Management
items.body: Our project management oversees timelines, budgets, and contractor coordination, delivering seamless execution from concept to completion for the client.
